{{Short description|American topologist (1941–2026)}}
'''Robert Jay Daverman''' (September 28, 1941 – February 9, 2026) was an American [[topologist]].

==Life and career==
Daverman was born in [[Grand Rapids, Michigan]], on September 28, 1941. He earned a bachelor's degree in 1963 from [[Calvin College]] and pursued doctoral study under [[R. H. Bing]] at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]]. After completing his thesis ''Locally Fenced 2-spheres in S<sup>3</sup>'' in 1967, Daverman began teaching at the [[University of Tennessee–Knoxville]].<ref>{{cite conference |last1=Guilbault |first1=Craig |contribution=Robert J. Daverman: a short mathematical tribute |date=May 2002 |contribution-url=https://sites.calvin.edu/venema/workshop/proceedingspapers/davermantribute.pdf|title=Proceedings Nineteenth Annual Workshop in Geometric Topology|publisher=Calvin College|pages=1–2}}</ref> While on the Knoxville faculty, Daverman served on the [[American Mathematical Society]]'s Committee on Science Policy.<ref>{{cite news |title=UA Dean Robert Olin Named Chair of American Mathematical Society Committee |url=https://news.ua.edu/2004/11/ua-dean-robert-olin-named-chair-of-american-mathematical-society-committee/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=University of Alabama |date=30 November 2004|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260308170952/https://archive.news.ua.edu/2004/11/ua-dean-robert-olin-named-chair-of-american-mathematical-society-committee/|archive-date=8 March 2026}}</ref> By the time he was selected as one of the inaugural fellows of the AMS in 2012, Daverman had gained emeritus status.<ref>{{cite news |title=Four Faculty Members Named American Mathematics Society Fellows |url=https://news.utk.edu/2012/11/05/american-mathematics-society-fellows/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=University of Tennessee–Knoxville |date=5 November 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220925103738/https://news.utk.edu/2012/11/05/american-mathematics-society-fellows/|archive-date=25 September 2022}}</ref> Daverman died on February 9, 2026, at the age of 84.<ref>[https://www.rosefuneraltn.com/obituaries/robert-bob-daverman/#!/Obituary Robert "Bob " Daverman]</ref>
